desc: Rugged reliability with a non-glare matte finish on the barrel and receiver that won't cause birds to flare. The durable composite stock and forearm are up to tough conditions. The hard working SXP action fires all factory 2 3/4", 3" and 3 1/2" steel, tungsten, bismuth and lead loads through a chrome plated .742" Back-Bored barrel with Invector-Plus™ chokes, ensuring optimum patterns.
